transcript.content: Hello. What brings you to the clinic today?

My primary care doctor urged me to come here after a routine department physical flagged some issues, but I'm really struggling with this. To be honest, I’m scared that if I start eating more, I’ll lose control and put on weight I can’t afford at my age and in my line of work.

To help me understand your eating patterns, do you currently severely limit how much food you eat, or do you sometimes experience episodes where you eat a large amount of food and then try to get rid of it?

I severely limit what I eat and never have episodes of overeating or trying to get rid of it. Most days I just get by on a black coffee in the morning and maybe a small piece of chicken or an apple late at night. Sitting down to a full meal just feels like I'm breaking discipline, so I avoid it.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently, and is your current weight considered underweight for your height and age?

Yes, my recent department physical flagged my weight as being significantly low, and my pants are hanging off me so much that I've had to punch extra holes in my duty belt. Even so, I still feel this constant urge to tighten up even further to avoid getting sloppy on the job.
Even though your doctor and your loose clothes show you are significantly underweight, how do you perceive your body shape or weight when you look in the mirror?

When I look in the mirror, I don't see a skinny guy; I just see a gut and flabby arms that make me feel like a failure as a cop and as a man. Keeping that number on the scale from going up feels like the only thing I still have any real control over in my life.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient meets all diagnostic criteria for Anorexia Nervosa, restricting type (ICD-10: F50.01). He exhibits severe restriction of energy intake leading to a significantly low body weight, an intense fear of gaining weight or becoming fat, and a significant disturbance in the way his body weight and shape are experienced (perceiving himself as having a 'gut and flabby arms' despite being objectively underweight). He explicitly denies any binge eating or purging behaviors, confirming the restricting subtype.
